hypothesis: Adding previously unused SpamAssassin examples may reduce false positives on an unused historical SpamAssassin slice; suggested after old-test disclosure, not a causal experiment.

normalization.policy: Unchanged frozen V2 parser and feature_text; retain EMAILTOKEN; no V3 ablation
normalization.csv: Already decoded subject/body -> feature_text; never interpret CSV as raw MIME
normalization.eml: Frozen corrected MIME parse_email, without attachments or envelope features
known_limits: Residual spam tags and header-like body text
HTML cleanup is not browser CSS visibility

calibration_selection.threshold_candidates: Every distinct calibration score plus nextafter(max_score,+infinity); tied scores handled together
calibration_selection.objective: Maximum unweighted mean recall across sources having at least one spam
calibration_selection.uncertainty: Constraints are empirical point estimates on calibration, not statistical guarantees
calibration_selection.failure: If no candidate passes, stop before holdout and old test; save every candidate's diagnostics without relaxing constraints

split.split_rule: Previously saved first fold of SGKF(2), label stratified, seed20261022; no reseeding

evaluation.uncertainty: Paired whole-group bootstrap,2000 resamples,95% percentile intervals; report small sample119spam and do not claim win if FPR interval includes0 or recall noninferiority is not supported
evaluation.regression_diagnostic: One V4 pass on previously used V2 holdout7614; compare saved V2 predictions. Diagnostic only, no further tuning.

provenance.license: Original message senders retain copyright; no blanketCC0; no raw publication
provenance.exclusion: Exclude all new components linked to any V1/V2/V3 used group or known-test text anchors without using test labels; audit saved
limitations: Heuristic near grouping does not guarantee campaign independence
Selected ham-heavy slice from historical sources, not modern Russian deployment
Original old1600 and V2 holdout already exposed
